entry.name: abl.dsp.waveshaper~
entry.description: A saturation effect with control over the waveshaping transfer function.

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: curve
attributes.digest: Waveshaper Curve
attributes.description: Adds mostly third-order harmonics to the input signal. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: damping
attributes.digest: Waveshaper Damping
attributes.description: Flattens signals near the origin of the waveshaper transfer curve. Damping behaves like an ultra-fast noise gate. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: dcblock
attributes.digest: DC Blocking

attributes.name: depth
attributes.digest: Waveshaper Depth
attributes.description: Superimposes a sine wave onto the waveshaper transfer function curve and sets its amplitude. [0., 1.]

attributes.name: drive
attributes.digest: Input Drive
attributes.description: Sets the gain in dB of the input signal before saturation. [-36., 36.]
